sandbachFocus: Sandbach United secured a dramatic 1-0 away victory at Brereton Social, with Robbie Hatton scoring a far-post volley in added time to snatch all three points. It was a cagey, low-quality affair with few chances for either side, but The Bach showed resilience to extend their unbeaten run and maintain their position near the top of the table despite missing top scorer Kieran O'Connell through unavailability.
divisionWide: Eccleshall claimed a thrilling 3-2 home win over Dawley Town in a five-goal thriller, with goals from Matt Jones, Nicky Parker, and Dylan Bath securing a comeback victory after being 2-1 down. Stafford Town held off Allscott Heath 2-1 despite conceding a late goal and surviving a penalty save from keeper Cooper, maintaining their mid-table position. AFC Bridgnorth dominated Shawbury United 4-0 at home to extend their exceptional unbeaten run at the top, while both Wolverhampton Casuals and Bilston Town shared the spoils in a dramatic 3-3 draw with late goals flying in. Wednesfield Community edged Telford Town 3-2 away in another goal-heavy contest, while Barnton and Foley Meir drew 2-2 with a late equalizer from Luke Lewis salvaging a point for the visitors. Market Drayton Town came from behind to beat Cheadle Heath Nomads 3-2 with a stunning extra-time volley from Manhertz, and Crewe secured a narrow 1-0 away win at Alsager Town to climb the table.
